items.title: Using AI Agents to Teach Robots Like Microduck to Walk in Simulation
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「Agent Skill、Harness、工具调用和自动化研发」。原文摘要显示：Teaching a robot to navigate an obstacle course requires more than a walking policy. It must perceive its surroundings, maintain balance, and adjust its actions...
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。

items.title: Running Frontier-Class AI Models Across 8 NVIDIA DGX Spark Nodes
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「AI 工具、开发者平台和工程提效」。原文摘要显示：AI developers aren’t just running a single model anymore—they’re orchestrating multiple models in parallel, chaining inference calls, and experimenting...
items.insightText: 优先找可复用的工程范式、组织实践和系统架构细节，低相关议题可直接跳过。
